verdict.rationale: Name.com's own docs list official SDKs for TypeScript, Go and PHP. The SDK page describes them as typed clients that map directly to the Core API reference, so the product itself delivers official SDKs to build against. Missing for 10: Python SDK (listed as 'coming soon'), any independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and deeper SDK documentation such as installation or usage examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official client SDKs for the name.com Core API. They give you typed clients that map directly to the API reference
TypeScript, Go, and PHP clients — Python coming soon
